remediation: Excluded from client annexures. Marked as follow-on FEED scope until full native SolidWorks A1 drawing sheet is compiled.

description: Report represented 13.8-minute NaHCO3 cooking time as an experimentally validated result when it was a computational model hypothesis.
root_cause: Conflation of computational simulation with physical wet-lab measurement.
remediation: Explicitly classified as HYPOTHESIS pending Phase 1/Phase 2A physical trials. No claims of physical validation permitted.

artifact: Dryer mass balance (13,241 kg/day solids + 1,654.3 kg/day water)
description: Claimed 10.0% wet-basis moisture, but 1,654.3 / (13,241 + 1,654.3) = 11.11% wet basis. 10.0% wet basis on 13,241 kg solids requires 1,471.2 kg water.
root_cause: Rounding and definition confusion between wet-basis and dry-basis moisture.
remediation: Unified master design basis: 15,000 kg/day incoming @ 10.5% WB moisture (13,425 kg solids + 1,575 kg water); finished product @ 10.0% WB moisture = 14,712.2 kg/day (13,241 kg solids + 1,471.2 kg water).

description: 0.50% on liquor basis (22,500 kg liquor) = 112.5 kg/day NaHCO3 vs. 0.50% on raw dal basis (15,000 kg dal) = 75.0 kg/day.
remediation: Locked in V8 Master Design Basis: chemical concentration is defined strictly on SOAK LIQUOR basis (0.50% w/w on 22,500 kg liquor = 112.5 kg/day NaHCO3, 7.5 kg per batch across 15 batches/day).
